meta.name: caching-strategy
meta.description: Implement efficient caching strategies using Redis, Memcached, CDN, and cache invalidation patterns. Use when optimizing application performance, reducing database load, or improving response times.

copy.tagline: 用缓存策略加速应用响应，减轻数据库压力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果应用响应慢、数据库负载高，需要引入缓存方案
copy.tagline_en: Speed up app responses and reduce database load with caching
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your app is slow or database is overloaded and you need caching

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Redis、Memcached、CDN 等工具实现缓存策略，提升应用性能、减少数据库负载和延迟。
howto.when: 当你要求优化性能、减少数据库查询负载、改善 API 响应时间，或实现缓存相关功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Redis 写一个缓存服务。
say.note: Claude 将生成 Redis 缓存服务代码。

say.text: 为我的静态资源配置 CDN 缓存。
say.note: Claude 会提供 CDN 缓存配置指南。

say.text: 设计一个缓存失效策略。
say.note: Claude 将解释多种失效模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help implement caching strategies using Redis, Memcached, CDN, etc., to improve application performance and reduce database load and latency.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to optimize performance, reduce database query load, improve API response times, or implement caching-related features.

say_en.text: Help me implement a Redis cache service.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Redis cache service code.

say_en.text: Configure CDN caching for my static assets.
say_en.note: Claude will provide CDN caching configuration guidance.
Claude will explain various invalidation patterns.
